answer: The crystal multiplier is published, charged in bridge, and jetty lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 16 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1810 identities would post 626 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
